summary: American evangelist David Berg founded the Children of God in California in 1968 and turned it into a worldwide sex cult that prostituted female members as flirty fishing and made the sexual abuse of children official doctrine.

evidence.note: born February 1919 to itinerant revivalist preacher parents
years as right-hand man to TV evangelist Fred Jordan in Texas, 1954-1967
daughters say he harassed one and molested the youngest from about age ten
Teens for Christ founded in Huntington Beach around 1968, later renamed Children of God
inner circle goes underground and moves to a London headquarters
flirty fishing developed in Tenerife, Canary Islands, from 1974
Davidito biography printed in Spain and used as a child-rearing manual documenting abuse
cult produces puppet TV shows for general audiences while abuse continues
granddaughter abused at a cult facility in the Philippines, then confined and beaten
Berg dies in 1994, buried in Portugal; Zerby takes over
Ricky leaves, kills his former abuser and then himself in the early 2000s

notes: Title gives Berg and the cult equal weight, so both are primary. covered_span ends 2005 (Ricky Rodriguez murder-suicide, year from own knowledge; transcript says early 2000s); that epilogue is only a few minutes, so 1994 is a defensible alternative end. Portugal (burial) mentioned only in passing and left out of setting. reaches_present rests on a short closing segment on Zerby still at large and current membership.
